MEET THE ARTIST / 검정치마

The Black Skirts

The Black Skirts is the solo project of singer-songwriter Bryan Cho, also known as Jo Hyu-il. Born in Seoul and raised in New Jersey, he makes music that moves between indie pop and rock.

INDIE ROCK / 2016

EVERYTHING

Official music video

Single: 2016 · TEAM BABY: 2017

View release on Apple Music ↗

First released as a single in 2016, “EVERYTHING” later appeared on the 2017 album TEAM BABY. The official music video accompanies this selection; the album link follows the song into the wider record.
